key_points: Walmart’s raised outlook and solid grocery/e-commerce performance are fundamentally supportive
The stock reaction was muted/negative despite the upgrade due to lower free cash flow and high expectations
Shift toward higher-income shoppers supports basket strength, but low-income pressure is a longer-term risk
PhonePe IPO news and defensive positioning versus Target are secondary for WMT valuation
Most headlines are generic or noise; the earnings/outlook signal is the main driver
